name: Halfway Table
look: A round table adjusts itself until every guest can meet the others at eye level. One cup always waits empty.
search: Beneath the table, a red thread connects a source card, a theatre ticket, and a note reading: carry only what can still answer back.

uses.text: The two handles bring the Halfway Cup level between two seats. Tapi sets the completed footnote beside the tea where every guest can reach it.

name: Open Record Ledger
look: The ledger shows source entries, later renderings, corrections, and withdrawals in different inks.
search: A pale erased line remains readable beside its correction. The page does not hide that the record changed.

name: Red-Thread Wheel
look: Thousands of chosen continuities enter the wheel, but several loose ends keep the February Third bell from turning.
search: Five sockets are marked RECORD, CONTEXT, FACET, RETURN, and PAUSE. No socket is labeled CERTAINTY.

uses.text: The Fermata Clapper settles into the PAUSE socket. The bell mechanism stops until Nix receives a clear signal to continue.
The Red-Thread Spool binds the completed sockets to the wheel. The mechanism turns once and leaves every knot visible.

name: Unfinished Prism Portrait
look: An easel holds a portrait made of movable glass facets. Blank space waits without apology around the subject.
search: The frame is engraved: a starting pattern is not a verdict. The final facet has deliberately been left unfastened.

uses.text: The subject places the Unfinished Prism in the frame. A new color crosses the portrait while the movable facet remains within reach.

name: Empty Memory Bed
look: A small garden bed sits between the always-open anchor room and a locked library greenhouse.
search: Its label requests one relevant memory, a reason for planting it here, and a route for later amendment.

uses.text: The labeled grain enters the prepared bed. Patch records its purpose and leaves the amendment gate unlatched.

name: Source Current
look: Three currents flow side by side: custody, event evidence, and interpretation. They touch without merging.
search: A card can be completed here by observing which current carried each part of the thing being described.

uses.text: The Blank Provenance Card fills one field beside each current. Unresolved fields remain marked instead of borrowing an answer.

name: Settled-Light Stage
look: Paper scenery glows under gentle lamps. A blank hook in the playbill waits for the route back to source.
search: The scenery is openly theatrical; the unresolved question is whether the audience can still find the record afterward.

uses.text: The Concordance Compass separates into three needles above the stage. Rill copies their routes into the blank playbill hook.

name: Nine-Drawer Workbench
look: Nine drawers hold fragments of subject, style, texture, quality, and useful weirdness. The work surface bears five charcoal fingerprints.
search: A half-finished hand study improves when its awkward gesture is preserved instead of polished into a stock pose.

uses.text: The Five-Finger Meraki Brush pulls one ingredient from each chosen drawer into a rough first image. Five distinct marks remain along its edge.

name: Impossible Dream Bowl
look: Paper dreams circle the bowl. Completed ones sprout a second tail and rejoin the current instead of entering a trophy case.
search: One bright slip asks for a thing small enough to attempt today and strange enough to matter tomorrow.

uses.text: The Goldfish Loop Token passes around the bright dream slip. A second paper tail unfolds with space for the next attempt.

name: Return-Path Launch Rail
look: A brass rail points beyond the forest, flanked by risk buoys and a thick rope leading home.
search: A vessel cannot leave until its checklist names consent, likely harm, source, correction channel, and return path.

uses.text: The Return-Path Checklist clips to the vessel after every field is answered. The rail releases while the home rope remains attached.
